scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production FORCE_COLOR=1 bun run --filter @eneo/ui build && NODE_ENV=production FORCE_COLOR=1 bun run --filter @eneo/web build && NODE_ENV=production FORCE_COLOR=1 bun run --filter @eneo/web-next build
scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development FORCE_COLOR=1 bash -c 'bun run --cwd packages/ui build:dev || exit $?; bun run --cwd packages/ui dev & ui_pid=$!; bun run --cwd apps/web dev & web_pid=$!; trap "kill $ui_pid $web_pid 2>/dev/null" INT TERM EXIT; wait $web_pid; status=$?; kill $ui_pid 2>/dev/null; wait $ui_pid 2>/dev/null; exit $status'
scripts.dev:clean: bun run clean:cache && bun run dev
scripts.dev:web-next: NODE_ENV=development FORCE_COLOR=1 bun run --cwd apps/web-next dev
scripts.dev:web-next:clean: bun run clean:cache:web-next && bun run dev:web-next
scripts.test: bun run test:web && bun run test:web-next
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:e2e:web && bun run test:e2e:web-next
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
